Other machinery and clinker/cement allocation are unchanged.

passenger_car_engine_aluminium.note: Premise passenger-car ICE aluminium correction v1: source gross aluminium is 61.875 kg, with 12.375 kg manufacturing scrap and 49.5 kg retained per nominal 275 kg drivetrain (Notter et al. 2010, supporting Table S2, https://doi.org/10.1021/es903729a; Althaus and Gauch 2010, Table 80). Replace the native 170.07 kg gross input and scale its manufacturing and post-consumer scrap by 61.875/170.07 together. Post-consumer recovery retains the native 82.62188% of retained aluminium as an unvalidated treatment proxy. Other treatment flows/emissions and nominal masses are unchanged; the remaining steel, fluid/reference-mass and treatment mass gaps are unresolved. No balancing residue or new recovery rate is inferred.
passenger_car_engine_aluminium.reference: https://doi.org/10.1021/es903729a, supporting Table S2; Althaus and Gauch 2010 Table 80; docs/methodology/transport/passenger-cars.rst
passenger_car_engine_aluminium.qualification: Native post-consumer recovery is retained as an unvalidated treatment proxy. Signed source-output and supplier-chain guards retain the original system-model scope.
